lines.zh: 我走在树干背面，脚步贴着树皮。
lines.en: I walk on the far side of trunks, hugging the bark.

lines.zh: 我绕树，一圈一圈，不发出声音。
lines.en: I circle the tree ring by ring without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从一堵墙后面走到另一堵。
lines.en: I move from one wall's back to another's.

lines.zh: 树叶挡着我，我的肩还是露了一点。
lines.en: The leaves hide me, though my shoulder shows.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，影子留在墙后。
lines.en: I walk the wall's base; my shadow stays behind it.

lines.zh: 你转身，我就在树的另一边。
lines.en: You turn; I am on the tree's other side.

lines.zh: 我走路时不出声，树枝替我响。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; the branches speak for me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退进灌木，眼睛还留在外面。
lines.en: I ease back into the brush, my eyes still out.

lines.zh: 我换了一棵树，距离没变。
lines.en: I change trees; the distance stays the same.

lines.zh: 我沿栅栏走，找到一块缺的板。
lines.en: I follow the fence and find a missing board.

lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，落叶也不响。
lines.en: I step on fallen leaves, and they make no sound.

lines.zh: 我走到你侧后方，那里有棵树。
lines.en: I walk to your flank, where a tree stands.

lines.zh: 我贴着树站着，像多出来的一块皮。
lines.en: I stand against the trunk like an extra layer of bark.

lines.zh: 我不动，连风也绕开我。
lines.en: I stay still, and even the wind goes around me.

lines.zh: 我在墙角蹲着，数落下来的叶子。
lines.en: I crouch in the corner and count falling leaves.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸压得很低，树在替我喘。
lines.en: I keep my breath low; the tree breathes for me.

lines.zh: 我等你自己走到我的树前。
lines.en: I wait for you to walk to my tree on your own.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进树皮，扣出五个洞。
lines.en: My fingers dig into the bark, leaving five holes.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，脖子没有动。
lines.en: I watch a long time without moving my neck.

lines.zh: 这片林子太安静，我替它守着。
lines.en: This wood is too quiet; I keep watch for it.

lines.zh: 我数树的年轮，数到自己那一圈。
lines.en: I count tree rings and stop at my own.

lines.zh: 我在等一只鸟飞走，好挪个位置。
lines.en: I wait for a bird to leave so I can shift.

lines.zh: 我蹲在墙后，膝盖压着干草。
lines.en: I crouch behind the wall, knees on dry grass.

lines.zh: 太阳移到我脸上，我往里缩了缩。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches my face; I shrink back a little.

lines.zh: 我把身体折成树影的形状。
lines.en: I fold my body into the shape of a tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 我听见你开门，还是没动。
lines.en: I hear you open the door and still do not move.

lines.zh: 我从树后探出半张脸。
lines.en: I lean half my face out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 你一看我，我就忘了自己在做什么。
lines.en: When you look at me, I forget what I was doing.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在叶缝里，一直没眨。
lines.en: My eyes sit in the leaf gap, never blinking.

lines.zh: 我们对视一秒，我的骨头响了一下。
lines.en: Our eyes meet for a second, and my bones click.

lines.zh: 我探头，只想看你在不在看我。
lines.en: I peek out only to see if you are looking.

lines.zh: 你移开视线，我又把脸伸出来一点。
lines.en: You look away, and I push my face out further.

lines.zh: 我躲在墙后，只让一只眼露出来。
lines.en: I hide behind the wall, letting one eye show.

lines.zh: 对视那一下，我整个人都换了。
lines.en: In that one look, all of me changes.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，忘了树皮硌着脸。
lines.en: I stare at you, forgetting the bark against my cheek.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔动了一下，我也动了一下。
lines.en: Your pupil shifts; so do I.

lines.zh: 我数你眨眼的次数，数到第四下。
lines.en: I count your blinks and reach the fourth.

lines.zh: 我探头时，树叶擦过我的耳朵。
lines.en: As I peek out, a leaf grazes my ear.

lines.zh: 你看过来，我却没有躲。
lines.en: You look my way, and I do not hide.

lines.zh: 我看见你的眼睛，不知该走该留。
lines.en: I see your eyes and cannot tell whether to go or stay.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴在树皮上，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I press my face to the bark and show one eye.

lines.zh: 你一抬眼，我的头就缩回半寸。
lines.en: You look up and I pull my head back half an inch.

lines.zh: 隔着两棵树，我数你的睫毛。
lines.en: Two trees away, I count your eyelashes.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在枝杈上，看你。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a fork of branches and watch you.

lines.zh: 你举起火把，我的影子先退。
lines.en: You raise a torch; my shadow backs away first.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，等你再看第二眼。
lines.en: I hold my breath and wait for your second glance.

lines.zh: 你的剑削下一块皮，像削树皮。
lines.en: Your blade shaves a strip off me like bark.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，血抹在树上。
lines.en: I retreat behind the tree, blood smeared on it.

lines.zh: 我不喊疼，只是呼吸变快了。
lines.en: I do not cry out; my breathing just quickens.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我想起自己也会死。
lines.en: This cut reminds me I can die too.

lines.zh: 我捂住伤口，指缝里都是红的。
lines.en: I cover the wound; red fills my fingers.

lines.zh: 你打中我时，树也跟着晃。
lines.en: When you hit me, the tree sways too.

lines.zh: 我退半步，还是没离开这棵树。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and still do not leave the tree.

lines.zh: 伤口的味道让林子安静下来。
lines.en: The smell of the wound quiets the wood.

lines.zh: 你追过来，我绕着树躲。
lines.en: You come after me; I dodge around the trunk.

lines.zh: 疼让我更想看清你的脸。
lines.en: Pain makes me want a better look at your face.

lines.zh: 你举着食物朝树后晃。
lines.en: You wave food toward the tree's far side.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想看你举多久。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I want to see how long you hold it up.

lines.zh: 那块面包在林子里显得很白。
lines.en: That bread looks very white in this wood.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，退开两步。
lines.en: You set the food down and back off two steps.

lines.zh: 我从树后看食物，不看你。
lines.en: I watch the food from behind the tree, not you.

lines.zh: 食物会引鸟，鸟会引你抬头。
lines.en: Food draws birds, and birds make you look up.

lines.zh: 我不伸手，伸手就得离开这棵树。
lines.en: I do not reach; reaching means leaving this tree.

lines.zh: 你在树下留了一整夜的苹果。
lines.en: You leave an apple under the tree all night.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，可我更想闻你的手。
lines.en: I smell it, but I would rather smell your hand.

lines.zh: 等我确定你走了，才会去拿。
lines.en: I will take it once I am sure you are gone.

lines.zh: 你撞上树，也撞上了我。
lines.en: You hit the tree, and you hit me too.

lines.zh: 我贴着树没让开，你就挤过来。
lines.en: I stay flat against the trunk; you squeeze past.

lines.zh: 我的肩很硬，像一段旧木头。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard as an old piece of wood.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你才发现树后有人。
lines.en: Touching me, you learn someone is behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我不推你，只是往树后缩。
lines.en: I do not push you; I only shrink further behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我们的呼吸在树皮下撞了一下。
lines.en: Our breaths collide under the bark.

lines.zh: 你退开时，树皮上留着手印。
lines.en: When you pull back, a handprint stays on the bark.

lines.zh: 我站着，像树多长了一条腿。
lines.en: I stand there like the tree grew an extra leg.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住我的脚背，我没动。
lines.en: Your boot presses my instep; I do not move.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我的位置暴露了。
lines.en: That touch gives my position away.

lines.zh: 这林子里只有我，和很多树。
lines.en: There is only me in this wood, and many trees.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，我只需要一棵好树。
lines.en: I need no mate, only a good tree.

lines.zh: 我对着树影站，像在等谁回来。
lines.en: I stand with the tree's shadow, as if waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 两个跟踪者会互相看不见。
lines.en: Two stalkers would lose sight of each other.

lines.zh: 我把最好的位置留给另一个我。
lines.en: I save the best hiding spot for another me.

lines.zh: 若成双，我们就一左一右看你。
lines.en: If paired, we would watch you from either side.

lines.zh: 树后只够站一个，所以一直只有一个。
lines.en: Only one fits behind a tree, so there has only ever been one.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，林子把声音吞了。
lines.en: I call once, and the wood swallows the sound.

lines.zh: 我学着别人的样子靠近，学不像。
lines.en: I try to approach the way others do, and fail.

lines.zh: 我抱着树干，像抱着同类。
lines.en: I wrap my arms around the trunk like kin.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片叶子，又放回去。
lines.en: I lift a leaf and set it down again.

lines.zh: 地上的东西让我离树太远。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the ground pulls me too far from the tree.

lines.zh: 我只捡能挡住脸的东西。
lines.en: I only pick up things that can hide a face.

lines.zh: 你掉下的地图，我看了很久。
lines.en: I study the map you dropped for a long time.

lines.zh: 我把碎石堆在树根，好站稳。
lines.en: I pile stones at the roots to brace my feet.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的火把，吹灭了。
lines.en: I pick up your torch and blow it out.

lines.zh: 东西在你脚边，我不去拿。
lines.en: The thing lies by your feet; I do not go for it.

lines.zh: 我收着一块布，擦树皮上的血。
lines.en: I keep a cloth to wipe blood off the bark.

lines.zh: 我捡东西时眼睛一直朝你那边。
lines.en: Even picking things up, my eyes stay on your side.

lines.zh: 这颗扣子还带着你衣服的线头。
lines.en: This button still trails a thread from your coat.

lines.zh: 你在这片林子里走得太久了。
lines.en: You have walked this wood too long.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你开始看树后面。
lines.en: I pick you because you have started checking behind trees.

lines.zh: 你停下来听，我就知道你察觉了。
lines.en: You stop to listen, and I know you suspect.

lines.zh: 这棵树和你之间只有七步。
lines.en: Seven paces lie between this tree and you.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的范围，我伸直了背。
lines.en: You enter my range, and I straighten my back.

lines.zh: 我开始记你走路的节奏。
lines.en: I begin memorizing the rhythm of your walk.

lines.zh: 你回头找了两次，方向都对。
lines.en: You look back twice, both times correctly.

lines.zh: 我选中你，因为你不喊人。
lines.en: I choose you because you do not call for help.

lines.zh: 你的火光在树缝里晃，我跟上了。
lines.en: Your torchlight sways between trunks; I follow.

lines.zh: 我松开树皮，这就是决定。
lines.en: I let go of the bark; that is the decision.

lines.zh: 你走的方向只有一条路。
lines.en: The way you are headed has only one path.

lines.zh: 我记住你鞋底的花纹了。
lines.en: I have memorized your boot tread.

lines.zh: 今晚的林子归我，你也在内。
lines.en: Tonight the wood is mine, and so are you.

lines.zh: 你在树下站定，我不必再等。
lines.en: You stop under the tree; I need wait no longer.

lines.zh: 你开始数树了，我数你。
lines.en: You have started counting trees; I count you.

lines.zh: 这片影子选了我，也选了你。
lines.en: This patch of shade chose me, and it chose you.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树换到下一棵。
lines.en: I move from one tree to the next.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我换半棵树的位置。
lines.en: You take a step; I shift half a tree over.

lines.zh: 我总在你视线的边缘。
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 你看左边，我就到右边那棵。
lines.en: You look left; I am at the right-hand tree.

lines.zh: 树与树之间，我算好了距离。
lines.en: I have measured the gaps between trunks.

lines.zh: 你加快脚步，我换树也加快。
lines.en: You hurry; my tree changes hurry too.

lines.zh: 我不出声，树叶替你出声。
lines.en: I stay silent; the leaves make your noise for you.

lines.zh: 你停下系鞋带，我在三棵树外。
lines.en: You stop to tie a lace; I am three trees away.

lines.zh: 我保持你回头看不见的距离。
lines.en: I keep the distance where turning shows nothing.

lines.zh: 你绕过灌木，我早到了那边。
lines.en: You round the bush; I am already past it.

lines.zh: 我的路线比你的短，因为我是直的。
lines.en: My path is shorter because it is straight.

lines.zh: 你在空地上，我就等在林线。
lines.en: You cross open ground; I wait at the treeline.

lines.zh: 你听见树枝响，那不是我踩的。
lines.en: You hear a branch snap; I did not step on it.

lines.zh: 天暗下来，树影都成了我的位置。
lines.en: As light fades, every tree shadow becomes my spot.

lines.zh: 你每绕一棵树，我就少一棵。
lines.en: Each tree you circle leaves me one fewer.

lines.zh: 我踩你的影子走，不踩你的声音。
lines.en: I walk on your shadow, not on your sound.

lines.zh: 你回头看的方向，总是慢半拍。
lines.en: The way you look back is always half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我算好你下一步会靠近墙。
lines.en: I have worked out that your next step nears the wall.

lines.zh: 风换了方向，我换到上风处。
lines.en: The wind turned, so I moved upwind.

lines.zh: 你在林边犹豫，我已经在那边。
lines.en: You hesitate at the treeline; I am already there.

lines.zh: 我从树后扑出来，先抓你领口。
lines.en: I lunge from behind the tree and grab your collar.

lines.zh: 我的指甲很短，掐进肉里很深。
lines.en: My nails are short and sink deep.

lines.zh: 你背对我那一刻，就是这一下。
lines.en: The instant you turn your back, the blow lands.

lines.zh: 我不喊，打人时也不喊。
lines.en: No shout leaves me, even mid-swing.

lines.zh: 我把你按在树干上，树皮蹭你的脸。
lines.en: I pin you to the trunk; bark scrapes your cheek.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，我退回树后。
lines.en: After the hit, I retreat behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我的手臂从叶子里伸出来。
lines.en: My arm comes out of the leaves.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我的手从下面进去。
lines.en: You raise a guard; my hand comes in low.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子，把你往回拖。
lines.en: I catch your sleeve in my teeth and pull.

lines.zh: 你砍中树，木屑落了我们一身。
lines.en: You hit the tree; splinters rain on us both.

lines.zh: 我打得很轻，只想让你转身。
lines.en: I strike lightly, only to make you turn.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我已经换了一棵树。
lines.en: By the time you fall, I am at another tree.

lines.zh: 我的手在你颈后停一下才用力。
lines.en: My hand rests at your neck a moment, then tightens.

lines.zh: 你闻到树汁味，那就是我靠近了。
lines.en: You smell sap; that is me drawing near.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里抽手出来。
lines.en: I draw my hand out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 这一下不响，只有树皮响。
lines.en: The blow makes no sound, only the bark does.

lines.zh: 林子深处多了一棵树，其实是我。
lines.en: A tree appears deep in the wood; it is me.

lines.zh: 我从你身后的墙里长出来。
lines.en: I grow out of the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 天黑了，树与树之间空出一块给我。
lines.en: Night falls, and a gap between trees is left for me.

lines.zh: 你先听见叶子响，然后才看见我。
lines.en: You hear leaves first, then see me.

lines.zh: 我在墙角站了一整夜才被看见。
lines.en: I stand in the corner all night before being seen.

lines.zh: 这片林子的影子够多，我借一个。
lines.en: This wood has shadows enough; I borrow one.

lines.zh: 我从树干里剥出来，皮还是湿的。
lines.en: I peel out of the trunk, my skin still damp.

lines.zh: 没有人召唤我，是树把我留下的。
lines.en: No one summoned me; the trees kept me.

lines.zh: 我在你扎营的地方先站好位置。
lines.en: I take my spot before you even make camp.

lines.zh: 第一片叶子落下时，我已经在了。
lines.en: By the first falling leaf, I am already here.

lines.zh: 我的身体和树皮是一个颜色。
lines.en: My body is the color of bark.

lines.zh: 你点火时，火光里多了一个影子。
lines.en: You light a fire, and a shadow joins the firelight.

lines.zh: 我从墙和树的夹角里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the angle between wall and tree.

lines.zh: 你数树的时候，多了一棵。
lines.en: When you count trees, there is one extra.

lines.zh: 我在树桩后面站起来，很高。
lines.en: I stand up behind a stump, very tall.

lines.zh: 夜水还挂在叶上，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: Night water still hangs on the leaves when I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从两堵墙的缝里挤出身子。
lines.en: I squeeze my body out of a gap between two walls.

lines.zh: 这片林子缺一棵树，我补上。
lines.en: This wood is short one tree, so I fill the place.

lines.zh: 鸟先看见我，才叫出声。
lines.en: A bird sees me first, and only then cries out.

lines.zh: 树影变长的时候，我有了脸。
lines.en: When the tree shadows lengthen, I have a face.

lines.zh: 火把我的树皮点着了，我不敢跑。
lines.en: Fire catches my bark, and I dare not run.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，落地没有声音。
lines.en: I drop from the tree and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的脸，我仍盯着岸。
lines.en: Water covers my face; I still stare at the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把树掀倒，我从树根里爬出来。
lines.en: The blast uproots the tree; I crawl out from the roots.

lines.zh: 箭钉在树干上，差一点就是我。
lines.en: The arrow pins the trunk, a hair from me.

lines.zh: 药水让我现形，我讨厌被看见。
lines.en: The potion reveals me; I hate being seen.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿只会让我更轻。
lines.en: I never eat; hunger thins me out.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我身后的树，我借光看你。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree behind me; I use the light to see you.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，手里还抓着一片叶子。
lines.en: I fall into the void still clutching a leaf.
